8ffe89d2-c521-4b3b-b6a6-bc42944c4e9f.title: Lucas — Refined quiet-desk typography
8ffe89d2-c521-4b3b-b6a6-bc42944c4e9f.visualDirection: Minimal Inter menu and compact AI composer over unchanged approved desk photograph. v1=image-only baseline, v2=GPT-5.6 Sol proposal, v3=mobile/focus corrections, v4=top-centred Brussels local-time badge with requested black/monospace/green treatment and mobile spacing adjustments. v5 reduces only the Brussels badge (desktop32px high; mobile24px high). v6=approved upright Newsreader 400 name with quieter Inter role/menu/chat, mobile input 16px and otherwise unchanged composition. v7=minimum 44px menu touch target correction. v8=one-second staggered entrance for name, role, About, Contact, and chat, with 8px upward movement, reduced-motion support and immediate completion on focus/open; About copy synchronized and Approach hidden. v9=removed composer focus-within highlight and input focus-visible outline; autofocus, typing, and focus indicators for other controls retained.

review.chat: Design preview uses local example replies; the implemented frontend calls POST /api/v1/lucasai/stream.

typography.fonts: Newsreader 400 identity; Inter interface; existing monospace clock
typography.overflow: No document overflow at reviewed sizes
typography.chatFocus: Opens on composer and restores focus to AI Chat on close
typography.sourcePreservation: Body markup and scripts identical to v5; exact photograph and clock retained

motion.verification: Browser confirmed stagger timing, stationary photograph, immediate completion on keyboard focus, no replay after closing a panel, and no overflow at 390x844. Reduced motion is disabled by CSS and checked on mount.

composerFocus.verification: Browser verified focused chat input and composer have outline-style none and box-shadow none, with INPUT still active.

implementation.chat: Streams from POST /api/v1/lucasai/stream via the existing backend proxy.
implementation.mobile: Preserves frontend edge-to-edge 100lvh image and clock safe-area offsets. Sheets follow VisualViewport for the keyboard. Compact landscape avoids clock overlap.
implementation.verification: 89 existing tests and production build passed; composer focus appearance verified in the browser.
